Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Peja Stojaković?

Peja Stojaković is 49 years old.

Where was Peja Stojaković born?

Peja Stojaković was born in Slavonska Pozega, Croatia.

When was Peja Stojaković born?

Peja Stojaković was born on June 9, 1977.

How tall is Peja Stojaković?

Peja Stojaković is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much did Peja Stojaković weigh when playing?

Peja Stojaković weighed 229 lbs (103 kg) when playing.

Is Peja Stojaković in the Hall of Fame?

Peja Stojaković is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Peja Stojaković drafted?

Peja Stojaković was drafted by Sacramento Kings, 1st round (14th pick, 14th overall), 1996 NBA Draft.

What position did Peja Stojaković play?

Small Forward.

When did Peja Stojaković retire?

Peja Stojaković last played in 2011.

What is Peja Stojaković's net worth?

Peja Stojaković made at least $97,956,720 playing professional basketball.

How much did Peja Stojaković make?

Peja Stojaković made $14,896,000 in 2011.

What did Peja Stojaković average?

Peja Stojaković averaged 17.0 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 1.8 assists per game.

How many rings does Peja Stojaković have?

Peja Stojaković won one championship.
